purpose: Publication integrity checks, not performance or integration acceptance
credential_signature_scan: no matches in snapshot; exporter regex and omitted-credentials documentation excluded as false positives
excluded: raw SSE, compiled binaries, environments, model weights, bulk generated groups, tensor fixtures and credentials
execution_checks: No tests, linters, builds, GPU loads or service changes were run for publication
review_status: Source snapshot only; experimental output attribution unresolved; no performance admission
publication_authorization: User explicitly requested branch commit and push; earlier no-push instruction superseded for this branch only
merge_back: skip; user has not authorized production merge

git_whitespace_check.decision: Retain exact original seed bytes and SHA; do not reformat frozen evidence

independent_package_review.scope: Read-only snapshot manifest, local mirror/worktree hashes, key source dependencies, original license, credential signatures and documentation
independent_package_review.limitations: No tests or SSH repeated by reviewer; source snapshot is not current-main integration validation

git_tracking.reason: Root .gitignore excludes benchmarks/**/*.json; use package-scoped explicit allowlist for reviewed files only
